# Bootstrap 5.3.8

Locally served upstream distribution files; no npm or frontend build required.

- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.8/dist/css/bootstrap.rtl.min.css
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.8/dist/js/bootstrap.min.js
- License: https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/blob/v5.3.8/LICENSE (included)

Only the collapse navigation needs JavaScript. The non-bundle distribution avoids
Popper, which this layout does not need. Keep CSS and JS versions aligned when updating.
